priorities.heading: AFFORDABILITY/TAXES
priorities.quote: Not only are household and family costs increasing but everyday Americans are being buried under federal, state, and local taxes, sales taxes, real estate and personal property taxes, tolls, and more government mandated expenses.

priorities.heading: FIGHTING GOVERNMENT CORRUPTION, FRAUD, AND WASTE
priorities.quote: I intend to reduce financial burdens on the American public by reducing government waste and redistributing those funds to other necessary programs on which so many Americans need and rely.

priorities.heading: CRIME CONTROL/SELF SUFFICIENCY
priorities.quote: I intend to increase funding to community programs to establish strong partnerships with Americans who want to create change and lead programs and incentives in their own communities.

health-care.heading: PROTECTING MEDICAID, MEDICARE, AND SOCIAL SECURITY
health-care.quote: As Americans, we must demand proper funding of Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security programs.

climate-energy.heading: Energy and Natural Resources
climate-energy.quote: Lower energy cost, Edwin support an all-of-the above energy platform.

priorities.heading: ENSURING EVERY CHILD HAS ACCESS TO A QUALITY EDUCATION
priorities.quote: As Chairman of the House Education and Labor Committee, Congressman Scott worked with President Biden to draft the education provisions of the American Rescue Plan Act, which helped reopen our schools with the single largest federal investment in K-12 public schools in America’s history and provided billions of dollars to our Historical Black Colleges and Universities.

priorities.heading: WORKING TO REFORM OUR NATION’S BROKEN CRIMINAL JUSTICE SYSTEM
priorities.quote: Since his first term in Congress, Congressman Scott has fought for comprehensive, evidence-based criminal justice reform. That is why he opposed the 1994 Crime Bill, which contributed to mass incarceration, destroyed communities, and did nothing to reduce crime.

priorities.heading: ADDRESSING CLIMATE CHANGE, PROTECTING THE ENVIRONMENT, AND BUILDING A RESILIENT HAMPTON ROADS
priorities.quote: Congressman Scott also supported the Inflation Reduction Act, which is the single largest federal investment ever to address climate change and includes language drafted by Congressman Scott for investment and production tax credits for new clean, green energy.

cost-of-living.heading: FIGHTING FOR AMERICA’S WORKERS
cost-of-living.quote: He has sponsored the Raise the Wage Act to gradually increase the federal minimum wage from $7.25 an hour to $17 an hour – if enacted, this would be the first increase in the federal minimum wage since 2009; previous versions of Rep Scott's bill have passed the House, but failed in the Senate.

health-care.heading: EXPANDING ACCESS TO HEALTHCARE AND LOWERING COSTS FOR SENIORS
health-care.quote: He also supported the Inflation Reduction Act, which lowers the cost of healthcare by reducing premiums in the ACA Marketplace, caps the price of insulin at $35 for seniors in Medicare, and lowers the costs of prescription drugs for seniors by finally allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices.

foreign-policy.quote: On protecting our region's defense interests, Bobby is an active member of the Congressional Shipbuilding Caucus and is a leading advocate for shipbuilding, shipbuilders, and our men and women in uniform.
foreign-policy.note: This passage is about defense spending. The site doesn't discuss wars or conflicts abroad.

climate-energy.heading: ADDRESSING CLIMATE CHANGE, PROTECTING THE ENVIRONMENT, AND BUILDING A RESILIENT HAMPTON ROADS
climate-energy.quote: Congressman Scott also supported the Inflation Reduction Act, which is the single largest federal investment ever to address climate change and includes language drafted by Congressman Scott for investment and production tax credits for new clean, green energy.
